About me

Art meets
technology
meets chaos.

Versatile Creative Content Producer with a unique blend of artistic vision and technical skill. I hold two concurrent degrees — Photography, Film & Design at West University and Computer Science at Politehnica — which lets me think like an artist and execute like a developer.

Specialised in visual storytelling: from video editing and motion graphics to complete brand identities and social media campaigns. I create digital experiences from concept to screen.
